extracted.geometry_description: Annular cross-section of a cooling-water pipe: D = { x : r0 < |x| < R }, with outer radius R = 0.5 m (a pipe of diameter 1 m, scaled to unit size for benchmark comparison) and initial inner radius r0 = 0.1 m. The outer circle Γ_o is a fixed boundary (pipe casing); the inner circle Γ_i is a design boundary (tube wall).

designed.domain_description: Annular pipe cross-section D = { r0 < |x| < R } with fixed outer radius R = 0.5 m (label 3, environment-facing casing, Robin + radiation) and inner radius r0 = 0.1 m (label 2, cooling-water side, design boundary).
